messages:
Maya (Billing): Heads up — Nebula Labs says their preview (id 99412) in the portal omitted the "reserved GPU hours" line and that a duplicate preview 99412-copy appeared. Final invoice had the GPU line but amounts didn't match what their dashboard showed. Can we triage?
Jorge (Backend): Pulling worker logs for the preview window. I see the preview generator called the usage-aggregator which returned a partial page due to a faulty pagination cursor. Snippet:
```
preview_worker.go:278: startPreview(customer=nebula, window=2026-03-21T00:00Z->2026-03-21T06:00Z)
2026-03-21T04:07:12Z INFO: calling usage-aggregator page_token="token-42"
2026-03-21T04:07:13Z WARN: aggregator returned page_next="token-43" but items_count=0
2026-03-21T04:07:13Z ERROR: mergeUsagePages: got page with no items, skipping
2026-03-21T04:07:13Z INFO: publish_preview(customer=nebula, id=99412)
```
Jorge (Backend): The bug is that receiving an empty page erroneously short-circuits the merge path and we publish whatever we have so far. If the first page has the compute lines but the second page has reserved lines and the second page is empty, we drop reserved lines.
Priya (Engineering Ops): We also saw a duplicate preview entry because the preview generator doesn't check the idempotency key when a retry succeeds after a transient aggregator hiccup. So one run created 99412 (incomplete) and a later retry created 99412-copy.
InvoiceBot: [job 11411] preview created customer=nebula preview_id=99412 status=complete
InvoiceBot: [job 11412] preview created customer=nebula preview_id=99412-copy status=complete
Maya (Billing): Nebula wants assurance of the correct dollar amount before unpausing payment. Can Engineering estimate delta and timeline?
Jorge (Backend): Quick local repro: forcing aggregator to return an empty second page yields the missing reserved line. Patch idea: treat empty page with page_next as transient — attempt fetch-next up to N times before deciding page is empty. Also ensure aggregation keeps a seen-page-token set to avoid loops. I'll open a PR.
Priya (Engineering Ops): I'll add an idempotency index check in the preview store: if a preview exists for (customer, billing_window, idempotency_key) don't create a new preview record; instead update the existing one. That prevents duplicates in the portal. Also adding metrics for empty-page events.
Eli (Finance): Can we produce a quick reconciliation for Nebula showing the expected preview total after the fix? I'll prepare a tentative credit offer in case numbers changed.
Jorge (Backend): Ran a staging replay after applying the empty-page retry logic and idempotency fix. Staging preview 99412 shows both the GPU and reserved lines and total = $4,812.75 (matches usage-store). Command: `./scripts/replay_preview --customer nebula --window 2026-03-21T00:00Z/2026-03-21T06:00Z --env staging`
InvoiceBot: [job 11450] preview recreated customer=nebula preview_id=99412 status=complete (staging)
Priya (Engineering Ops): Plan for prod rollout: patch -> 15m warm -> run dry-run replay for affected windows -> if dry-run matches staging totals, run live replay for 2026-03-21 windows. I'll schedule deploy at 11:15 UTC.
Maya (Billing): Please attach the regenerated PDF and a short reconciliation CSV to this thread when ready. I'll hold off contacting the customer until we have numbers.
Support (Customer Ops): I'll standby to send the update and offer a one-time service credit if needed.
Jorge (Backend): Patch merged to main. Deploying now.
InvoiceBot: [deploy] preview-service v1.8.3 deployed to production by Priya
Priya (Engineering Ops): Warmed services for 12 minutes, dry-run replay results: totals match staging, reserved GPU line present. Now running live replay for 2026-03-21T00:00Z->2026-03-21T06:00Z.
InvoiceBot: [job 11477] replay completed customer=nebula invoice=99412 regenerated_pdf_url=https://internal/redwood/invoices/99412.pdf
Jorge (Backend): Attached regenerated PDF and reconciliation: reserved_gpu=120h @ $10.00/hr = $1,200.00, compute=360k tokens = $3,612.75, total=$4,812.75. No duplicate preview entries in portal.
Maya (Billing): Got the PDF. I'll send the email to Nebula and offer a $50 goodwill credit while we apologize for the confusion. Eli ok?
Eli (Finance): $50 credit approved. Please CC me on the outbound.
Maya (Billing): Will do. Closing loop: root cause = aggregator pagination handling + missing idempotency guard on preview publish. Fixes deployed, replayed, invoice regenerated, credit approved. Marking this resolved; reopen if Nebula reports anything odd. :white_check_mark:
